Key points
• The purpose of this article is to share publicly available information on maize ﬂour, oil, rice, salt, and wheat ﬂour forti-
ﬁcation programs globally.
• Several documents are developed by country stakeholders to shape and guide fortiﬁcation programs. Three were reviewed:
legislation, standards, and regulatory monitoring protocols.
• There are many aspects of fortiﬁcation programs that can be evaluated to determine if they are operating optimally or as
